note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript of the doctor–patient encounter.
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

Notes:
- The note will be produced exactly in the requested structure:
  Subjective:
  Objective:
  Assessment & Plan:
  1. Issue/Problem/Request 1
  2. Issue/Problem/Request 2
  3. Issue/Problem/Request 3 (and so on as applicable)
  - For each issue: name, assessment, consistent DDx (with likelihood if available), planned investigations, treatments, and referrals.
- I will treat the transcript as the primary factual source and use the DDx only when consistent with the transcript. If conflicts exist, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”
- I will extract only clinically relevant information: presenting complaint details (onset, duration, progression), PMH, meds, allergies, social history, physical findings, investigations, working diagnosis, management, and follow-up.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- All notes will be in American English, concise, professional, with bullet points.

Also please ensure patient de-identification if sharing sensitive data. Once you provide the transcript and DDx, I will generate the complete SOAP note.
